thought.text: Now I'll start the Docker build in the background (it involves building 3 images) and monitor progress.

reasoning_content:
Alright. Next, I'll start the Docker build. Since it'll take a while, I'll launch it in the background and poll for completion.

Command: `cd /workspace && docker compose up -d --build`

The image build for tooling (php alpine + imagick + node) might take a few minutes. Same goes for the API build. web_application runs npm ci + next build (sharp download, etc.).

Let's start it in the background using nohup, and output the logs to a file.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup docker compose up -d --build > /tmp/compose_up.log 2>&1 &
echo "started pid $!"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && nohup docker compose up -d --build > /tmp/compose_up.log 2>&1 &\necho \"started pid $!\"", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Start docker compose up --build in background"}

summary: Start docker compose up --build in background
